# Data Summary Report

## Section 1 - Overview
```{r}
#libraries
library (ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(here)

#data
sites <- c("JP-Tef", "US-Akn", "DE-GsB", "FR-EM2")
snapshots <- read.csv(here("data", "snapshots", "fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20261113T105848.csv"))

overview <- snapshots |> 
    filter(site_id %in% sites) |> 
    select(site_id, site_name, location_lat, location_long, igbp, first_year, last_year, data_hub, network, product_citation)

# map 
lat <- overview$location_lat
long <- overview$location_long

world <- map_data("world")
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey90", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = overview, aes(x = long, y = lat), colour = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = overview, aes(x = long, y = lat, label = site_id),
            size = 3, vjust = -0.8) +
  #coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-10, 30), ylim = c(35, 60)) +   # zoom to Europe
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")
```

## Section 2 - Data coverage
```{r}
# heatmap
data <- read_csv(here("data", "complete_data.csv"),
                 col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c",
                                  site = "c", time = "-", .default = "d")) |>
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"))

nee_share <- data|>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(share_measured = mean(NEE_VUT_REF_QC %in% 0),   # TRUE = 1, FALSE = 0
            n_halfhours    = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(nee_share, aes(x = year, y = site, fill = share_measured)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Share measured",
                       labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Site",
       title = "Share of half hours with measured NEE (QC = 0)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

Best coverage site: by JP-Tef, since it is the longest one (2001-2023)
Years are best covered from 2017-2022

## Section 3 - Summary statistics
```{r}
vars <- c("TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F", "NEE_VUT_REF",
          "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF", "H_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS")

units <- c(TA_F            = "°C",
           SW_IN_F         = "W m⁻²",
           VPD_F           = "hPa",
           P_F             = "mm; Mean = annual sum in mm yr⁻¹",
           NEE_VUT_REF     = "µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹",
           GPP_NT_VUT_REF  = "µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹",
           RECO_NT_VUT_REF = "µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹",
           H_F_MDS         = "W m⁻²",
           LE_F_MDS        = "W m⁻²")

# 1. Mean, min, max and % missing per site and variable
summary_long <- data |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(site, variable) |>
  summarise(all_na        = all(is.na(value)),
            Mean          = if (all_na) NA_real_ else mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            Min           = if (all_na) NA_real_ else min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            Max           = if (all_na) NA_real_ else max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Missing (%)` = 100 * mean(is.na(value)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  select(-all_na)

# 2. Precipitation: mean of the annual sums
p_annual <- data |>
  group_by(site, year = year(time)) |>
  summarise(p_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(p_mean_annual = mean(p_sum))

summary_long <- summary_long |>
  left_join(p_annual, by = "site") |>
  mutate(Mean = if_else(variable == "P_F", p_mean_annual, Mean)) |>
  select(-p_mean_annual)

# 3. Reshape: statistics as rows, variables (with units) as columns
headers <- paste0(vars, " (", units[vars], ")")

site_tables <- summary_long |>
  mutate(variable = factor(paste0(variable, " (", units[variable], ")"), levels = headers)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Mean, Min, Max, `Missing (%)`), names_to = "Statistic") |>
  mutate(Statistic = factor(Statistic, levels = c("Mean", "Min", "Max", "Missing (%)"))) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value, names_sort = TRUE) |>
  arrange(site, Statistic)

# 4. one table per site
for (s in unique(site_tables$site)) {
  assign(paste0("summary_", gsub("-", "_", s)),
         site_tables |> filter(site == s) |> select(-site))
}

print(summary_DE_GsB)
print(summary_FR_EM2)
print(summary_JP_Tef)
print(summary_US_Akn)
``` 

## Section 4 - Time Series
```{r}
flux_vars <- c("NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")
conv <- 1.0378   # µmol CO2 m-2 s-1  ->  g C m-2 d-1

# 1. Aggregate half-hourly data to daily values
daily <- data |>
  mutate(date = as_date(time)) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(flux_vars),
                   list(val = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * conv,
                        n   = \(x) sum(!is.na(x)))),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  # only keep days that have all 48 half hours
  mutate(NEE  = if_else(NEE_VUT_REF_n     == 48, NEE_VUT_REF_val,     NA),
         GPP  = if_else(GPP_NT_VUT_REF_n  == 48, GPP_NT_VUT_REF_val,  NA),
         RECO = if_else(RECO_NT_VUT_REF_n == 48, RECO_NT_VUT_REF_val, NA)) |>
  select(site, date, NEE, GPP, RECO)

# 2. Plot: one panel per site
daily |>
  pivot_longer(c(NEE, GPP, RECO), names_to = "flux", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(flux = factor(flux, levels = c("GPP", "RECO", "NEE"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value, colour = flux)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(GPP = "#1b9e77", RECO = "#d95f02", NEE = "#3d3d3d")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Flux (g C m"^-2*" d"^-1*")"), colour = NULL,
       title = "Daily NEE, GPP and RECO") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# 3. Check against the FLUXMET_DD file for one site
check_site <- "DE-GsB"

zip_file <- list.files(here("data", "raw"),
                       pattern = paste0(check_site, ".*\\.zip$"),   # only this site's zip
                       full.names = TRUE)
dd_name  <- grep("FLUXMET_DD", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
unzip(zip_file, files = dd_name, exdir = here("data", "raw", "unzipped"))

dd <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "unzipped", dd_name),
               na = "-9999",
               col_select = c(TIMESTAMP, all_of(flux_vars)),
               col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP = "c", .default = "d")) |>
  mutate(date = as_date(TIMESTAMP, format = "%Y%m%d"))

comparison <- daily |>
  filter(site == check_site) |>
  inner_join(dd, by = "date")

# Differences (should be close to 0)
comparison |>
  summarise(NEE_max_diff  = max(abs(NEE  - NEE_VUT_REF),     na.rm = TRUE),
            GPP_max_diff  = max(abs(GPP  - GPP_NT_VUT_REF),  na.rm = TRUE),
            RECO_max_diff = max(abs(RECO - RECO_NT_VUT_REF), na.rm = TRUE),
            NEE_r         = cor(NEE, NEE_VUT_REF, use = "complete.obs"))

# Visual check: points should lie on the 1:1 line
ggplot(comparison, aes(x = NEE_VUT_REF, y = NEE)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "NEE from FLUXMET_DD (g C m⁻² d⁻¹)",
       y = "NEE aggregated from HH (g C m⁻² d⁻¹)",
       title = paste("Check of daily aggregation –", check_site)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Section 5 - Diurnal Cycle
```{r}
# Latitude per site (adjust column names to your snapshots table)
site_info <- snapshots |>
  distinct(site = site_id, lat = location_lat)

season_levels <- c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")

diurnal <- data |>
  left_join(site_info, by = "site") |>
  mutate(
    month = month(time),
    # meteorological seasons for the northern hemisphere
    season_nh = case_when(month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
                          month %in% 3:5         ~ "Spring",
                          month %in% 6:8         ~ "Summer",
                          TRUE                   ~ "Autumn"),
    # southern hemisphere: shift by half a year
    season = if_else(lat >= 0, season_nh,
                     recode(season_nh, Winter = "Summer", Summer = "Winter",
                                       Spring = "Autumn", Autumn = "Spring")),
    season = factor(season, levels = season_levels),
    # hour of day, centred on the half hour (00:00–00:30 -> 0.25)
    hour = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60 + 0.25
  ) |>
  group_by(site, season, hour) |>
  summarise(NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
            LE  = mean(LE_F_MDS,    na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(c(NEE, LE), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("NEE", "LE"),
                           labels = c("NEE (µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹)", "LE (W m⁻²)")))

# Safety check: every site needs a latitude
stopifnot(!anyNA(site_info$lat[site_info$site %in% unique(data$site)]))

ggplot(diurnal, aes(x = hour, y = value, colour = site)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ season, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 6), limits = c(0, 24)) +
  labs(x = "Hour of day (local standard time)", y = NULL, colour = "Site",
       title = "Mean diurnal course of NEE and LE by season") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", legend.position = "bottom")
```
### Seasonal Shift
For sites in the southern hemisphere (latitude < 0°), the seasons are shifted by six months: December–February is summer, March–May is autumn, June–August is winter and September–November is spring.

## Sectio 6 - Reading data
```{r}
data |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(NETRAD_avail = mean(!is.na(NETRAD)),
            G_avail      = mean(!is.na(G_F_MDS)),
            .groups = "drop")

eb_site <- "FR-EM2"   #site with NETRAD and G

eb <- data |>
  filter(site == eb_site,
         H_F_MDS_QC == 0, LE_F_MDS_QC == 0) |>          # H and LE measured
  mutate(turbulent = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS,
         available = NETRAD - G_F_MDS) |>
  filter(!is.na(turbulent), !is.na(available))

# Linear fit: turbulent fluxes ~ available energy
fit   <- lm(turbulent ~ available, data = eb)
slope <- coef(fit)[["available"]]
icpt  <- coef(fit)[[1]]
r2    <- summary(fit)$r.squared

label <- sprintf("Slope = %.2f\nIntercept = %.1f W m⁻²\nR² = %.2f\nn = %d",
                 slope, icpt, r2, nrow(eb))

ggplot(eb, aes(x = available, y = turbulent)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "blue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.5) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = expression(R[n] - G ~ "(W m"^-2*")"),
       y = expression(H + LE ~ "(W m"^-2*")"),
       title = paste("Energy balance closure –", eb_site),
       subtitle = "Half hours with measured H and LE (QC = 0); red dashed = 1:1, blue = linear fit") +
  theme_minimal()

# how much is gap filled?
qc_vars <- c("NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS_QC")

gapfill_site <- data |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(qc_vars),
                   \(qc) round(100 * mean(qc > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                   .names = "{sub('_QC', '', .col)} gap-filled (%)"),
            .groups = "drop")

gapfill_site
```


### Summary
The site in France takes up most carbon in spring and summer, while the site in Germany takes up more carbon in winter and the site in Japan in autumn. 
The site in France has the largest seasonal cycle.
Nice to see the mean diurnal cycle and was supprised that there is so inconsistent data and so much gap-filled. 
The site in Japan is gap-filled
